svg.text: Profile-Separated Fitness Progression Across Cohorts (No Cross-Regime Pooling)
Each cohort uses its own native objective definition and scale (qualified count = 0).
Panel A — Cohort 1 (Run 1): 17-Gen Search Fitness (1,984 Births, Gen 0–16)
Panel B — Cohort 2 (Run 31): 3-Gen Weighted Reporting Trajectory (Runs 31–36)
Panel C — Cohort 3: Ten Retained 800-Gen Runs (Run 2–Run 11, 1,954,560 Rows)
